source: University of Portland 2009-10 Men's Basketball Media Guide
completeness_basis: Portland's game-by-game Gonzaga table supplies four rows in every season from 1946-47 through 1957-58.
Portland's independent series note states that from 1946-50 Portland went 7-9 against Gonzaga; the first 16 game-by-game rows reproduce exactly that 7-9 Portland record.
The guide states that some records prior to 1950 were incomplete, so no broader claim is made beyond the exact Gonzaga series rows and the independently matching 1946-50 series accounting.
date_policy: The series table does not print game dates. Dates remain blank rather than being reconstructed from secondary chronology.
site_policy: Portland H/A is inverted reciprocally to Gonzaga A/H. Portland X remains Gonzaga UNKNOWN.
game_type_policy: Rows are accepted as regular-season series games. Portland's documented NAIA national-tournament opponent lists for the period do not identify Gonzaga, and the Gonzaga series table carries no postseason marker on these rows.
pdf_screenshot_attempt: The web screenshot endpoint was invoked on the official PDF but failed because the 35.8 MB file exceeded the screenshot fetch limit. The official PDF's parsed game-by-game table was available and used; no visual-only fact is asserted.
